MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The glue and foam mounting tape fit my repair work because they offer ways to join or mount parts where my transparent tape and casting resin are less convenient.",
    "The wire brushes connect naturally to my cutting wheels and metalworking supplies because cleaning rust and preparing metal can be part of the same job, provided the brushes fit my equipment."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Raspberry Pi converter and breadboards assume I am building electronic circuits, while my recent purchases support fastening, fabrication, inspection and measurement.",
    "The disposable masks do not meet a current need, and the large casters require a cart or workbench project I do not have planned.",
    "The bolt assortment suits my work but duplicates supplies I already own; the ultrasonic cleaner is appealing, but I do not yet have enough parts-cleaning work to choose it now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning inspection and measurement tools seems to have been taken as interest in electronic circuit building, even though those are different activities for me.",
    "My repeated hardware purchases seem to have been taken as a reason to suggest more similar assortments without considering how much they overlap with what I already bought."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Useful additions solve a related task my existing supplies do not cover, such as thicker mounting tape or brushes for preparing metal.",
    "Interest in workshop equipment does not mean I need every tool now: a cleaner needs enough cleaning work, and heavy-duty casters need a specific build.",
    "The dimensions, fastener sizes and equipment compatibility matter when deciding whether something complements my existing supplies."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my repair and fabrication work, but stretched that interest into unrelated projects and overlooked existing supplies and immediate needs."
}
